prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a hit while turning left in Baytown, Texas, and has shoulder injury. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1250; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thanks for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the collision you were involved in while driving in Baytown, Texas. Do you understand that this conversation is being recorded?

A: Yes, I understand.

Q: Please tell me in your own words what happened.

A: I was turning left at an intersection with a green light. I had my signal on and I waited for a gap in oncoming traffic. When I started into the turn, a vehicle coming from the opposite direction struck the front driver's side of my car.

Q: Did you see the other vehicle before the impact?

A: Not really. I looked before I turned, but it came up fast. I think it might have been speeding or had its lights off, but I can't say for certain.

Q: How fast would you estimate you were going when you began the turn?

A: I was going slowly, maybe ten or fifteen miles per hour. I was almost stopped to make sure the way was clear.

Q: Were you wearing your seatbelt?

A: Yes, I was.

Q: Can you describe any injuries you have experienced since the collision?

A: My left shoulder hurts quite a bit. It was pushed hard against the door and seatbelt during the impact. I have been having trouble lifting my arm above my head and sleeping on that side. I went to urgent care that same day and they took X-rays and told me to follow up with a specialist.

Q: Have you received any treatment since then?

A: I have a follow-up scheduled and I'm doing physical therapy twice a week. The pain is still there, though it's a little better than it was.

Q: Is there anything else you would like to add about the incident?

A: Only that I was being careful and I believe the other driver was at fault. Thank you.

Q: Thank you. That concludes the statement.
